headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Castagnoli & Moxley vs. Best Friends fought it out in a Parking Lot Fight match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 8.59 ? a genuine showstealer in a back-and-forth tag team affair. In a rematch of their famous 2020 parking lot brawl, Moxley and Castagnoli traded car-hood slams and fork shots with Best Friends in a violent, weapon-filled fight through a Jacksonville parking lot.
Rewind to 2021, when AEW welcomed Daniel Garcia for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.43.
Turning the clock back to 2023: after 12 matches, Anna Jay AS debuted a bold new identity: Anna Jay, on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2021, when Lee Johnson stepped back through the curtain after 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
That Wednesday in 2021, Leyla Hirsch made their return to AEW television after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
That Wednesday in 2021, Juventud Guerrera made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Chris Jericho, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.63.
